properties.title: Colombia M7.4 Earthquake - Cali
properties.summary: Magnitude 7.4 earthquake struck Chocó region near Cali. 224+ dead, 1,200+ injured, 3,700 missing. National emergency declared. GDACS Red.

properties.title: US MH-60 disables M/V Vela Nova - Gulf of Oman
properties.summary: US Navy MH-60 helicopter fired Hellfire missiles into engine room of Panama-flagged cargo ship attempting to break Iran port blockade. Third vessel stopped since July 14. 55 ships redirected total.

properties.title: IRGC attacks UAE tanker - Strait of Hormuz
properties.summary: IRGC reports UAE oil tanker under attack and burning in US-supported shipping route. 15 ADNOC vessels attacked since war began. Iran demands US concessions for Hormuz reopening.

properties.title: Ukraine strikes Novorossiysk naval base
properties.summary: Zelenskyy confirmed Palianytsia drone-missiles and Neptune cruise missiles struck Russian Black Sea Fleet base at Novorossiysk. Emergency power outage in Gelendzhik and Novorossiysk.

properties.title: Russian drone attack on Kyiv oblast warehouses
properties.summary: Russian drones attacked warehouses in Brovary district, Kyiv oblast. One person wounded. Fire at storage facility.

properties.title: Russian strikes in Pavlohrad - 5 wounded
properties.summary: At least 5 wounded as result of Russian strikes in Pavlohrad, Dnipropetrovsk oblast.

properties.title: Drone strike damage in Zaporizhzhia
properties.summary: Damage reported in Zaporizhzhia city as result of drone strikes. Ongoing aerial attacks.

properties.title: FIRMS thermal anomaly 140 MW - Zaporizhzhia oblast
properties.summary: VIIRS S-NPP thermal anomaly FRP 140.68 MW confidence HIGH. Acquired 2026-08-11 0934Z. Nearest feature: frontline combat zone south of Zaporizhzhia city.

properties.title: SAF recaptures Kurmuk - Blue Nile state
properties.summary: Sudanese Armed Forces report recapture of Kurmuk from RSF/SPLM-N Tasis coalition after months of heavy fighting. Mass graves discovered with 25 civilians including hospital staff. Strategic border town near Ethiopia guards Al-Roseires Dam.

properties.title: Houthi shelling on government forces camps - Yemen
properties.summary: Yemeni media reports casualties in shelling by Houthis (Ansar Allah) on two government forces camps in Marib and Hadramawt provinces.

properties.title: IDF urgent evacuation warning - Mansouri, Lebanon
properties.summary: Israeli army issues urgent evacuation warning for residents of southern Lebanon village of Mansouri ahead of planned strikes. Ongoing IDF operations in southern Lebanon.

properties.title: Three-missile attack wounds 2 in Iraqi Kurdistan
properties.summary: Iranian Kurdish opposition party reports 2 wounded in three-missile attack on positions in northern Iraq.

properties.title: Ukrainian drone attacks on Russian Kuban region
properties.summary: RT editor Simonyan offered assistance to families of those killed in Ukrainian drone strikes on Kuban. Ongoing cross-border strikes in Krasnodar Krai.

properties.title: Drone falls and explodes in Moldova - Stefan Voda district
properties.summary: Moldovan police: drone fell and exploded in village of Crocmaz, Stefan Voda district, near Ukrainian border. Incident prompts Russian warning on Transnistria.
